content.identity: 개인의 생존 기록과 채집·제작 선택이 다음 하루의 가능성을 바꾸는 나의 생존기로 처음부터 다시 설계한다
coreLoop: Fight through an escalating horde in a short real-time survival run while positioning around enemy pressure.
Collect run rewards or experience and choose upgrades, perks, weapons, or skills that change the current build.
Combine upgrades into a stronger build, survive harder waves or a boss, then convert the run result into the next progression choice.

signatureSystems.name: readable survival needs
signatureSystems.purpose: Survival needs are the basic needs required for survival in the game world.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Player chooses their survival needs to determine their starting equipment and resources.

signatureSystems.name: resource-to-crafting decisions
signatureSystems.purpose: Players must gather resources to craft new equipment and improve their survival skills.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players must decide how to allocate their resources to craft new equipment and improve their survival skills.

signatureSystems.name: exploration risk and recovery
signatureSystems.purpose: Exploration and recovery are crucial aspects of survival in the game world.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players must balance exploration and recovery to survive in the game world.

technicalAssumptions: Players must have a device with a screen and a keyboard to play the game.
Players must have an internet connection to play the game online.
Players must have a stable internet connection to download and update the game.
validationQuestions: Is the game world realistic and immersive?
Is the game mechanics and systems logical and intuitive?
Is the game challenging and rewarding?
Is the game's story and narrative engaging and coherent?
openQuestions: What are the core gameplay mechanics and systems of the game?
How does the game's world and mechanics change over time?
What are the player's goals and objectives in the game?
How does the game's story and narrative evolve over time?
